title: Fragments on 2 Corinthians
blurb: Cyril of Alexandria, Fragments on 2 Corinthians: a fresh English translation of the surviving Greek fragments of his comments on Paul's Second Letter to the Corinthians (PG 74). Cyril reads the letter for what it shows about Christ: the Son is God by nature, the Spirit is free and not created, the glory of the law gives way to the greater glory of the gospel, Christ was made sin for us, and the body will be clothed with incorruption.
first_english_note: No English translation of these fragments appears in the Ante-Nicene or Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers. This is a fresh English translation made from the Greek of PG 74; no modern English version was used.

text_history.method: Fresh English translation from the Greek of PG 74.
